'''Grehollo station''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military base in the [[Grehollo system/Legends|Grehollo system]], charged with patrolling the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Captivity]]. Its complement included [[TIE/rc starfighter]]s.
